tasks.title: Setup Project Infrastructure and Dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with required dependencies including FastA2A, PydanticAI, Anthropic Claude API, Redis, Postgres, and Flutter setup
tasks.details: Create project structure with Python 3.12+ backend and Flutter mobile app. Install core dependencies: FastA2A v2.0+, PydanticAI v3.0, Anthropic SDK, Redis v7+, Postgres v15+, scikit-learn. Setup Kubernetes deployment configs with Uvicorn servers. Configure environment variables for API keys (Claude, Instacart). Initialize Git repository with proper .gitignore for Python/Flutter. Setup CI/CD pipeline basics.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all dependencies install correctly, test basic connectivity to Redis/Postgres, validate API key configurations, ensure Kubernetes configs are valid

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Agent System Architecture
tasks.description: Build the 5-agent system using PydanticAI with FastA2A for agent-to-agent communication: Pantry Manager, Instacart Integration, Recipe Chef, Budget Analyst, and Reflection & Feedback agents
tasks.details: Create PydanticAI agents with specific roles: Pantry Manager (Haiku for inventory), Recipe Chef (Sonnet 4 for complex reasoning), Budget Analyst, Instacart Integration, Reflection & Feedback. Implement FastA2A JSON-RPC over HTTP/SSE for A2A communication with context_id sharing. Each agent should handle specific tools and maintain <500ms latency. Setup async communication patterns and error handling with retries.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for each agent, integration tests for A2A communication, latency testing to ensure <500ms response times, test multi-turn interactions and context sharing

tasks.title: Develop Memory and Context Persistence System
tasks.description: Implement layered memory system with short-term (Redis), long-term (Postgres), and agent-specific context persistence using context_id for cross-session recall
tasks.details: Build 3-layer memory: L1 (Agent RAM), L2 (Redis with 1hr TTL), L3 (Postgres for long-term). Implement context_id system for sharing data between agents and sessions. Create compression using Haiku for context summarization. Store user preferences like '$200 budget' with 100% recall accuracy. Implement cache invalidation and fallback mechanisms. Use standardized A2A message format: {'context_id': 'abc123', 'data': {...}}.
tasks.testStrategy: Test cache hit ratio targets (85%), verify cross-session context recall, test compression effectiveness, validate fallback mechanisms, measure cache performance

tasks.title: Implement Token Management and Optimization
tasks.description: Build intelligent token routing system between Claude Haiku and Sonnet 4, implement compression techniques, and batch A2A messages for 25-40% cost savings
tasks.details: Create routing logic: Haiku for simple queries (<2K tokens), Sonnet 4 for complex reasoning. Implement prompt compression achieving 40-60% reduction. Build CompressedWorker class for batching A2A messages. Add token monitoring with <16K token limits per query. Implement retry logic with compression on token overflows. Track pre/post metrics for cost validation. Setup alerts for >10K tokens/query.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure token usage before/after optimization, validate 25-40% cost savings, test routing accuracy, verify compression doesn't affect quality, test retry mechanisms

tasks.title: Integrate Instacart API and External Services
tasks.description: Implement Instacart API integration for real-time pricing and shopping list generation, with proper error handling and rate limiting
tasks.details: Integrate Instacart Developer API for pricing data and shopping lists. Create API client with proper authentication and rate limiting. Implement schema handling for items array and prices. Add error handling for API failures with fallback to cached data. Build tools for agents to interact with Instacart services. Ensure compliance with API usage limits and implement exponential backoff for retries.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API connectivity and authentication, validate pricing data accuracy, test rate limiting and error handling, verify fallback mechanisms work correctly

tasks.title: Build Flutter Mobile Application with Core Features
tasks.description: Develop cross-platform Flutter mobile app with voice-first interface, offline support using SQLite, and integration with backend A2A system
tasks.details: Create Flutter app supporting iOS 15+ and Android 10+. Implement voice-first interface using speech-to-text plugin with >95% accuracy. Build offline mode with SQLite for local caching, sync on reconnect with batch processing (<10 items). Create UI for agent interactions and context management. Implement dark mode auto-detect and responsive design. Add proper error handling and loading states.
tasks.testStrategy: Test voice transcription accuracy, verify offline functionality and sync, test cross-platform compatibility, validate UI responsiveness, test error handling

tasks.title: Implement Adaptive Personalization System
tasks.description: Build ML-powered personalization using scikit-learn to predict user preferences from historical data and usage patterns
tasks.details: Implement scikit-learn models for predicting user preferences based on historical interactions. Create pattern recognition for common behaviors (e.g., '$200 budget suggests rice'). Build recommendation engine that learns from user feedback and context. Implement privacy-compliant data collection with user consent. Create feedback loops for continuous improvement. Ensure predictions integrate seamlessly with agent responses.
tasks.testStrategy: Test prediction accuracy against historical data, validate privacy compliance, test feedback loop effectiveness, measure recommendation relevance

tasks.title: Develop Single-Page Marketing Website
tasks.description: Create responsive single-page website with hero section, features, testimonials, newsletter signup, and app download links using HTML/CSS/JS with Tailwind
tasks.details: Build SPA with sections: Hero, Features (3-column cards), How It Works (steps), Testimonials (auto-advancing carousel every 5s), Newsletter form with email validation, Download/Footer. Implement dark mode toggle and PWA support. Use Tailwind CSS for styling with mobile-first responsive design (<768px breakpoint). Optimize for <2s load time with lazy-loading images. Ensure WCAG AA compliance with >4.5:1 contrast ratio.
tasks.testStrategy: Test load time performance, verify responsive design across devices, validate accessibility compliance, test form functionality and carousel behavior

tasks.title: Implement Security and Authentication System
tasks.description: Build comprehensive security system with JWT authentication, AES-256 encryption, role-based access control, and GDPR compliance
tasks.details: Implement JWT authentication for A2A communication and user sessions. Setup AES-256 encryption for data at rest in Redis and Postgres. Create role-based access control for user contexts and admin functions. Implement input sanitization to prevent injection attacks. Add rate limiting on APIs. Build audit trails for security operations. Ensure GDPR compliance with user consent management and right to deletion.
tasks.testStrategy: Security penetration testing, validate encryption implementation, test authentication flows, verify GDPR compliance features, test rate limiting effectiveness

tasks.title: Build Monitoring and Analytics System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring for token usage, cache performance, system health, and user analytics with real-time dashboards
tasks.details: Create monitoring dashboard showing KPIs: token usage, cache hit ratios (target 85%), latency metrics, cost tracking. Implement health monitoring for memory leaks and system performance. Setup alerts for >10K tokens/query and system anomalies. Build audit logs for security and compliance. Integrate with app analytics for user engagement metrics. Create automated reports for stakeholders.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all metrics are accurately tracked, test alert systems, validate dashboard functionality, ensure audit logs are comprehensive

tasks.title: Conduct End-to-End Testing and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing including load testing, integration testing, and performance optimization to meet all KPI targets
tasks.details: Execute end-to-end testing covering all user flows from voice input to agent responses. Conduct load testing for 10K concurrent users and 5x scale handling. Optimize performance to achieve <1s response for 95% of tasks. Test offline/online sync scenarios. Validate all acceptance criteria from PRD. Perform A/B testing on key features. Fix performance bottlenecks and optimize token usage.
tasks.testStrategy: Load testing with realistic user scenarios, performance benchmarking against KPI targets, integration testing across all components, user acceptance testing

tasks.title: Deploy Production System and Launch Preparation
tasks.description: Deploy the complete system to production environment with Kubernetes, setup monitoring, and prepare for beta/GA launch
tasks.details: Deploy backend services to Kubernetes with auto-scaling (min 2 instances). Setup Redis clustering and Postgres sharding for scalability. Deploy mobile app to app stores (iOS/Android). Launch marketing website with SEO optimization. Configure production monitoring and alerting. Setup backup and disaster recovery procedures. Prepare launch materials and user documentation. Conduct final security audit.
tasks.testStrategy: Production deployment testing, verify auto-scaling works, test disaster recovery procedures, validate monitoring in production, final security audit

tasks.title: Implement V3.2 Multi-Provider LLM Support
tasks.description: Upgrade Bruno AI V3.1 to V3.2 with multi-provider LLM support (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) for enhanced flexibility, cost-efficiency, and performance optimization
tasks.details: Implement multi-provider LLM routing system based on agent roles and task complexity. Update BaseAgent to support dynamic LLM selection: Gemini 2.5 Flash for fast/simple tasks (Pantry Manager, Instacart Integration), Claude 4 Sonnet for reasoning/creative tasks (Recipe Chef, Reflection & Feedback), OpenAI GPT-4o for complex forecasts and financial analysis (Budget Analyst). Add LLM router with fallback mechanisms, provider-specific error handling, and cost optimization strategies. Target 30% latency reduction and 20-40% cost savings via optimal routing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test LLM routing accuracy, validate fallback mechanisms, measure latency improvements, verify cost savings, test provider-specific error handling, validate response quality across providers

subtasks.title: Create LLM Router System
subtasks.description: Implement dynamic LLM selection based on agent roles and task complexity
subtasks.details: Create llm_router function that selects optimal LLM provider based on agent_id: Gemini 2.5 Flash for pantry/instacart (fast tasks), Claude 4 Sonnet for recipe/reflection (reasoning), GPT-4o for budget (financial analysis). Include fallback logic to Claude if primary fails. Add cost and latency tracking.

subtasks.title: Update BaseAgent for Multi-Provider Support
subtasks.description: Modify BaseAgent class to support multiple LLM providers with unified interface
subtasks.details: Update BaseAgent.__init__ to use llm_router for model selection. Add provider-specific API key handling (OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Implement unified error handling for all providers. Add provider-specific retry logic and rate limiting.

subtasks.title: Update Agent Implementations
subtasks.description: Modify each agent to use its optimal LLM provider
subtasks.details: Update PantryManagerAgent to use Gemini 2.5 Flash for fast inventory checks. Update InstacartAgent to use Gemini 2.5 Flash for efficient API handling. Update RecipeChefAgent to use Claude 4 Sonnet for creative reasoning. Update BudgetAnalystAgent to use GPT-4o for financial analysis. Update ReflectionAgent to use Claude 4 Sonnet for nuanced iterations.

subtasks.title: Add Provider-Specific Error Handling
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for each LLM provider
subtasks.details: Add OpenAI-specific error handling (rate limits, API downtime). Add Google Gemini error handling (quota limits, service errors). Add Anthropic Claude error handling (token limits, model availability). Implement exponential backoff for each provider. Add fallback routing when primary provider fails.

subtasks.title: Update Requirements and Dependencies
subtasks.description: Add new LLM provider dependencies to requirements.txt
subtasks.details: Add OpenAI Python SDK (openai>=1.0.0). Add Google Generative AI SDK (google-generativeai>=0.3.0). Update PydanticAI to support multiple providers. Add environment variable configuration for all API keys. Update .env.example with new variables.

subtasks.title: Implement Cost Optimization Strategies
subtasks.description: Add intelligent routing to minimize costs while maintaining quality
subtasks.details: Implement cost-per-token tracking for each provider. Add smart routing to use cheapest provider for appropriate tasks. Implement response caching to reduce API calls. Add batch processing for multiple simple queries. Create cost monitoring dashboard.

subtasks.title: Update A2A Server for Multi-Provider Support
subtasks.description: Extend A2A server to handle multiple LLM providers
subtasks.details: Update A2A server to support provider-specific agent routing. Add health checks for all LLM providers. Implement provider-specific workers in FastA2A. Add load balancing between providers when multiple options exist. Update A2A message format to include provider info.

subtasks.title: Update Main Application
subtasks.description: Modify main.py to support multi-provider agent initialization
subtasks.details: Update agent initialization in main.py to use new multi-provider setup. Add provider health monitoring endpoints. Update API responses to include provider information. Add provider-specific configuration management. Update logging to track provider usage.

subtasks.title: Add Comprehensive Testing
subtasks.description: Create tests for multi-provider LLM functionality
subtasks.details: Add unit tests for LLM router functionality. Create integration tests for each provider. Add fallback mechanism tests. Create performance benchmarks for provider comparison. Add cost tracking validation tests. Test provider-specific error scenarios.

subtasks.title: Update Documentation
subtasks.description: Update documentation to reflect V3.2 multi-provider architecture
subtasks.details: Update README.md with V3.2 features and setup instructions. Add provider configuration guide. Update API documentation with new endpoints. Create troubleshooting guide for provider issues. Add performance metrics and cost optimization guide.
